title: Panic attack — overwhelming fear after the quake
scenario: Heart racing, cannot catch breath, chest tight, shaking, feeling of dying or losing control, but no physical injury.
steps: Sit down somewhere as safe and quiet as possible.
Slow your breathing: in through the nose for 4 counts, out through the mouth for 6. Repeat for several minutes.
Ground yourself: name 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear.
Remind yourself: panic peaks and passes, usually within minutes.
If you are helping someone else: stay calm, speak slowly, and breathe with them.
Chest pain and shortness of breath can also be a heart attack. If chest pain is crushing, spreads to arm or jaw, or does not ease as breathing slows — call 911.
do_not: Do not dismiss chest pain as 'just panic' if it is severe or unfamiliar.
Do not leave a severely panicking person alone.
